Schezwan Dosa recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Wednesday, December 13, 2017 - 3:09am

Ingredients




4 tbsp Ching's Schezwan Chutney
2 Cups Dosa Batter
1 tbsp Butter
Oil to Drizzle.

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Keep the pan hot and spread some oil on to it to make it greasy. Pour a ladle of batter on the pan spread it around in a circular manner into a thin crepe. Cook for 2-3 mins. 3 Step 2: 4 Add 1 tbsp of chings secret Schezwan chutney ½ tsp butter and spread evenly on the dosa. 5 Step 3: 6 Drizzle some oil and cook the dosa until crisp. 7 Fold and Serve Hot.

About

 Desi Chinese Dosa Recipe or Chinese Dosa Snack Recipe is very easy and quick to make at home without much ado. Many Indian eats Schezwan Dosa as snacks or side dish and it can even serve as a main dish, it is getting popular in sub-continent of Asia, the recipe is awesome and majestic, easy to make.
